messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, competitor official documents and/or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, and avoid treating R&S sales battle-card language as binding technical facts.[3][6][36][43]
### Evidence required
| Claim type to compare | Required evidence | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S signaling tester capabilities | R&S CMX500 formal specifications and Features & Functions documents, with document version, option codes, supported technologies, limits, and conditions; CMX500 specs are binding specifications, while the Features & Functions document is an overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[43] | CMX500 is confirmed as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and its feature document lists NR FR1/FR2 signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, application tests, IP traffic analysis, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI.[10] |
| R&S Wi-Fi signaling claims | CMX500 feature evidence for WLAN signaling options, including the option codes for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP/STA testing, 2x2 MIMO, and advanced encryption/authentication.[42] | Battle-card statements about integrated Wi-Fi signaling must be checked against CMX500 WLAN options rather than used alone.[5][9][29] |
| R&S non-signaling / production tester capabilities | Formal product specifications/features for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06, including option codes, ports, bandwidths, calibration conditions, and binding/non-binding data status.[18][19][22][61] | CMP180 is documented for production / wireless communication device testing with configurable multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture.[16][17] |
| R&S FR2 non-signaling claims | CMP200 specifications and features evidence for the 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 remote radio heads and the stated R&D/manufacturing applications.[20][21] | CMP200’s product data has conditions, and typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable data are not warranted product performance.[56] |
| R&S factory-line / production RF claims | CMW100 K06 specifications for Communications Manufacturing Test Set capabilities, RF DUT I/O, RF generator/analyzer, power meter, spectrum analyzer, supported standards, and production test specifications.[24] | CMW100 K06 specification types distinguish warranted specifications from non-warranted typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, and data without tolerance limits is not binding.[22] |
| Competitor capability or limitation claims | Competitor official documentation and/or third-party evidence, not only R&S internal battle cards.[3][6][36] | For amarisoft, current claims are from a single R&S internal battle card and should be verified with amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence before use in customer documents.[3] |
| Anritsu comparison claims | Anritsu official資料 and third-party evidence are required for Anritsu claims, because the R&S vs Anritsu page is sales positioning and not binding specifications.[4][6] | The Anritsu MX844030PC brochure can describe MX844030PC, MD8190A, and Virtual Signalling Tester, but cannot verify R&S advantages over CMX500.[6] |
| Keysight comparison claims | Keysight official資料 and third-party evidence are required for Keysight claims, because the R&S vs Keysight page is sales positioning and not binding specifications.[7][36] | Claims such as “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications.[36] |
| amarisoft comparison claims | amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence are required for amarisoft limitations such as no global footprint, remote-only support, no Wi‑Fi signaling, no production/ATE testers, and no non-signaling factory-line path.[26][27] | The amarisoft page says all current information comes from an R&S internal battle card and lacks amarisoft official documents.[26] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance / PTCRB / GCF claims | Formal accreditation, validation reports, test package option codes, test case lists, or official certification evidence are required.[29][38] | The amarisoft comparison table states conformance/operator-acceptance claims lack test package option codes or accreditation documents.[29] |
| NTN validation claims | Validation reports, PTCRB RFT version, and test case lists are required before claiming validated NTN leadership or “first validated” status.[38] | The Keysight comparison table says the NTN validation claim lacks a validation report, PTCRB RFT 555 version, or test case list.[38] |
| FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth and data-rate claims | Formal specifications or datasheets for both R&S and competitor products are required, because battle-card quick tables contain conflicts or unverified roadmap-style statements.[6][40] | The Keysight page says FR1 up to 18 GHz and 2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth are battle-card / roadmap sales claims that cannot be treated as existing CMX500 binding specifications.[40] |
| TCO, fewer boxes, fewer calibrations, throughput, or “future-proof” claims | A documented TCO calculation, measured throughput conditions, license/configuration assumptions, calibration assumptions, and comparable competitor configuration evidence are required.[32][38] | The Anritsu page says “fewer boxes / more capability” includes lower TCO and higher throughput sales messaging, but the source provides no TCO formula.[32] |
| Warranty, support, calibration, and service claims | Official R&S service/warranty/calibration documents and competitor official service/warranty/calibration evidence are required.[3][26][29] | R&S internal battle-card claims about competitor support, warranty, and calibration limitations require competitor official or third-party confirmation.[3][26] |
### Minimum comparison package
1. R&S product evidence: CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features & Functions Version 32 for signaling, WLAN, application, automation, and option claims.[43][10][42][44]  
2. R&S non-signaling evidence: CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 / Features Version 09, CMP200 Specifications Version 08.00 / Features evidence, and CMW100 K06 Specifications Version 05.00 for production and RF test claims.[18][19][21][24][61]  
3. Competitor evidence: official competitor datasheets, feature manuals, brochures, option lists, service/warranty/calibration documents, and third-party/accreditation evidence where certification or market acceptance is claimed.[3][6][36]  
4. Claim-control evidence: exclude or clearly label battle-card phrases such as “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof choice,” “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “first validated,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” unless independently supported by verifiable documents.[3][6][36]  
5. Configuration evidence: list exact product models, hardware units, software options, order numbers where available, frequency ranges, bandwidths, test modes, calibration intervals, environmental conditions, and whether the numbers are warranted specifications or non-binding typical/nominal/measured data.[22][43][56]

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, competitor official documents and/or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, and avoid treating R&S sales battle-card language as binding technical facts.[3][6][36][43]
### Evidence required
| Claim type to compare | Required evidence | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S signaling tester capabilities | R&S CMX500 formal specifications and Features & Functions documents, with document version, option codes, supported technologies, limits, and conditions; CMX500 specs are binding specifications, while the Features & Functions document is an overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[43] | CMX500 is confirmed as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD, and its feature document lists NR FR1/FR2 signaling, WLAN signaling, fading, application tests, IP traffic analysis, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI.[10] |
| R&S Wi-Fi signaling claims | CMX500 feature evidence for WLAN signaling options, including the option codes for 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, AP/STA testing, 2x2 MIMO, and advanced encryption/authentication.[42] | Battle-card statements about integrated Wi-Fi signaling must be checked against CMX500 WLAN options rather than used alone.[5][9][29] |
| R&S non-signaling / production tester capabilities | Formal product specifications/features for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06, including option codes, ports, bandwidths, calibration conditions, and binding/non-binding data status.[18][19][22][61] | CMP180 is documented for production / wireless communication device testing with configurable multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture.[16][17] |
| R&S FR2 non-signaling claims | CMP200 specifications and features evidence for the 5G NR FR2 nonsignaling one-box test solution with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 remote radio heads and the stated R&D/manufacturing applications.[20][21] | CMP200’s product data has conditions, and typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable data are not warranted product performance.[56] |
| R&S factory-line / production RF claims | CMW100 K06 specifications for Communications Manufacturing Test Set capabilities, RF DUT I/O, RF generator/analyzer, power meter, spectrum analyzer, supported standards, and production test specifications.[24] | CMW100 K06 specification types distinguish warranted specifications from non-warranted typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, and data without tolerance limits is not binding.[22] |
| Competitor capability or limitation claims | Competitor official documentation and/or third-party evidence, not only R&S internal battle cards.[3][6][36] | For amarisoft, current claims are from a single R&S internal battle card and should be verified with amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence before use in customer documents.[3] |
| Anritsu comparison claims | Anritsu official資料 and third-party evidence are required for Anritsu claims, because the R&S vs Anritsu page is sales positioning and not binding specifications.[4][6] | The Anritsu MX844030PC brochure can describe MX844030PC, MD8190A, and Virtual Signalling Tester, but cannot verify R&S advantages over CMX500.[6] |
| Keysight comparison claims | Keysight official資料 and third-party evidence are required for Keysight claims, because the R&S vs Keysight page is sales positioning and not binding specifications.[7][36] | Claims such as “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications.[36] |
| amarisoft comparison claims | amarisoft official資料 and third-party evidence are required for amarisoft limitations such as no global footprint, remote-only support, no Wi‑Fi signaling, no production/ATE testers, and no non-signaling factory-line path.[26][27] | The amarisoft page says all current information comes from an R&S internal battle card and lacks amarisoft official documents.[26] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance / PTCRB / GCF claims | Formal accreditation, validation reports, test package option codes, test case lists, or official certification evidence are required.[29][38] | The amarisoft comparison table states conformance/operator-acceptance claims lack test package option codes or accreditation documents.[29] |
| NTN validation claims | Validation reports, PTCRB RFT version, and test case lists are required before claiming validated NTN leadership or “first validated” status.[38] | The Keysight comparison table says the NTN validation claim lacks a validation report, PTCRB RFT 555 version, or test case list.[38] |
| FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth and data-rate claims | Formal specifications or datasheets for both R&S and competitor products are required, because battle-card quick tables contain conflicts or unverified roadmap-style statements.[6][40] | The Keysight page says FR1 up to 18 GHz and 2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth are battle-card / roadmap sales claims that cannot be treated as existing CMX500 binding specifications.[40] |
| TCO, fewer boxes, fewer calibrations, throughput, or “future-proof” claims | A documented TCO calculation, measured throughput conditions, license/configuration assumptions, calibration assumptions, and comparable competitor configuration evidence are required.[32][38] | The Anritsu page says “fewer boxes / more capability” includes lower TCO and higher throughput sales messaging, but the source provides no TCO formula.[32] |
| Warranty, support, calibration, and service claims | Official R&S service/warranty/calibration documents and competitor official service/warranty/calibration evidence are required.[3][26][29] | R&S internal battle-card claims about competitor support, warranty, and calibration limitations require competitor official or third-party confirmation.[3][26] |
### Minimum comparison package
1. R&S product evidence: CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features & Functions Version 32 for signaling, WLAN, application, automation, and option claims.[43][10][42][44]  
2. R&S non-signaling evidence: CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 / Features Version 09, CMP200 Specifications Version 08.00 / Features evidence, and CMW100 K06 Specifications Version 05.00 for production and RF test claims.[18][19][21][24][61]  
3. Competitor evidence: official competitor datasheets, feature manuals, brochures, option lists, service/warranty/calibration documents, and third-party/accreditation evidence where certification or market acceptance is claimed.[3][6][36]  
4. Claim-control evidence: exclude or clearly label battle-card phrases such as “Only R&S,” “safe and future-proof choice,” “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “first validated,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” unless independently supported by verifiable documents.[3][6][36]  
5. Configuration evidence: list exact product models, hardware units, software options, order numbers where available, frequency ranges, bandwidths, test modes, calibration intervals, environmental conditions, and whether the numbers are warranted specifications or non-binding typical/nominal/measured data.[22][43][56]

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。
